# Mark DK Berry dot com

**Patreon**: [https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies](https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies)

**YT**: [https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry](https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry)

---

## SPEED UPS

Everyone is trying to figure out best things for speed ups

Kijai is suggesting Sage Atnn (2.2) -> Patch Sol-Attn (mostly tested on Blackwell only) -> Easycache (gives me >50% speed up but at quality loss)

Minimax the developers clearly agree - [https://x.com/MiniMax_AI/status/2084745241589080491](https://x.com/MiniMax_AI/status/2084745241589080491)

A patch sol attn for 3060s specifically is here, and I have installed it but still not seeing much difference yet [https://github.com/Apache0ne/ComfyUI-fasterminimax](https://github.com/Apache0ne/ComfyUI-fasterminimax)

Sol explainer:

```
tau: controls the sparsity, higher = faster = poorer quality
start/end percent self explanatory, outside the range it will run whatever other attention you have patched like sage
min_tokens to filter small layers since no benefit there
int8_qk can be faster at low tau, no effect at higher
sink_cond important for H3 to avoid messing audio/conds
morton is better quality when it works, when not it causes blocky artifacts, experimental
```



**Some notes on what Sage Att, Mem Eff, Sol and Easycache do from Kijai**: 

*"Sage is minimal quality loss, "mem eff" on top of that just reduces peak VRAM use a bit, sol and cache methods are quality/speed compromises. Of course like with any speed improvement, you then have room to possibly improve other aspects like resolution. So "quality" is pretty relative"*

widgets_values:
# Mark DK Berry 

YouTube: [https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry](https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry)

Patreon: [https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies](https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies)

Workflows: [https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows](https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows)

---

## Latent Space Upscaler workflow

**Useage**: I made this specifically for dialogue clip upscaling as my other one doesnt work for mouth movements. This does.


NOTE: I prefer results from my pixel space upscaling workflow which is _"MBEDIT - MH3_r2v_SingleSampler_Detailer_vXX.json"_ and you can download it from here [https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows/tree/main/workflows_by_model/Minimax-H3](https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows/tree/main/workflows_by_model/Minimax-H3)

but unfortunately that one doesnt do a good job with dialogue clips and fights mouth movements, even with good prompting. 

So, I created this workflow specifically for dialogue clips.

---

## ISSUES/THINGS TO BE AWARE OF

- **OOMS will hit you in the 2nd sampler, and are a PITA after waiting 20 mins to find out it cant handle it**. But if you have dynamic memory in, no switches, and dont dump the models during the wf, you should be able to tweak the Latent Upscaler down a touch and get through the 2nd sampler without a restart, so long as you dont change setting further back. Then tweak it better for next go.</br>

- I would prefer to set `ref_image_size` in the main H3 node of first part of run, to "Max" but often have to go with "Match" instead to avoid OOMs and get higher resolution faster.



---

## Upscaler Model For This Workflow 

You could install whatever ones you think are best. I tried some others but didnt find them to be as good as this one. This one still needed tweaking to get right, and might need different settings for your rig.

- [https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler)

- [https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler)

---

## USING THIS WORKFLOW

It's not a v2v workflow like the pixel space upscaler _(see top of this note for that)_. This was created for upscaling dialogue clips.

***The following is for my 3060 RTX 12GB VRAM, 32 GB System ram as a guide for what to expect. Season to your tastes and setup.***

1. Set "H3 Reference to Video" node to resolution of 0.4 mp or higher if you can handle it. (for my dialogue clips I need at least 8 seconds, so its my limit vrs time)

2. Make a good prompt using the minimax prompt guide and an LLM, and provide your ref images for characters and scene.

3. Set the chunks to manage VRAM ceiling vrs Time. Set your speed Loras and speedups as required. (SLA is fast but reduced quality).

4. I do 8 steps for the main sampler (1st pass) and 5 sigmas (steps) for the 2nd pass.

5. set the Latent Upscaling node (LBH-123-AI notes will help you set it up) to 1.2mp to 1.4mp obviously the higher you go the better it will be, but also longer it will take and more likely to OOM. I leave it at 1.4mp, which takes 25 mins on my machine just for that 2nd pass (8 seconds).


**Example run**: ***960 x 384 x 8 seconds, upscaled to 1.4mp takes 30 mins (5 + 25) on my 3060 RTX (SLA disabled)***.

The end result is 1920 x 768 (1.4mp) ultra wide-screen x 8 seconds. For starting resolution I use 0.3 up to 0.67 but whatever you use it wont change the length of time in the 2nd pass sampler only the firs one. 0.3 can be as good as 0.67. _(it will run a lot slower if ref-image_size set to max and ooms on mine, so I leave mine at match)_.  

The above will need to be adjusted to suit your requirements. I use x1 scene ref image and x 4 character ref images, so it means I am limited and VRAM ooms easily. If you have less, you will have more headroom. 

Chunks (set to 2 or 4, can go up to 64) can help find the ceiling of your GPU VRAM, but wont help against initial spikes (most commonly these seem to happen entering the sampler stages).

Get a memory monitor outside of comfyui to work out your optimum settings vrs VRAM, RAM, and Swap use. I have videos discussing this on my YT channel.

widgets_values:
# SPEED UP STUFF

## August 2026

- SLA Attention comes from plagueKind and is very fast making 37 min run finish in 20 mins but it does degrade the result. Its best disaabled for good final result when upscaling, tbh.

- Lightx2v its 4 steps but I set it to 8 in sampler for best results. It makes a big difference to speed and I generally leave it in all the time the speed vrs impact is worth it.

- ComfyI Kitchen Attention I also leave this in and have replaced Sage Attn (2.2) completely with it now. Use one or the other.

- LwVRAM attention and Chunk feed forward. This is KJNodes stuff and I use them to get the best out of the VRAM ceiling. in this workflow I dont set it above 4 as the upscampler will max out the VRAM anyway and uses more than the first sample pass. you can raise chunks to 64 apparently but it will take a lot longer I expect. most I have done is 16. but it wont fix spikes. only the long term run ceiling.

## Sept 2026:

- David Snow tested many and ended up on drbaphs step600_ema_pruned (from drbaph) lora saying "both 4 and 8 steps. Since that lora is quite powerful, I find a setting of about 0.4 is good with 8 steps. that's the sweet spot."

- Kijai version of flashgen 4 steps - https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/tree/main/loras - recommended strenght setting is not known.
worked best at strength 1 and steps 6. finished 10 sec video at 960 x 544 x 10 seconds in 540 seconds (about 10 mins). it was as long as drbaphs but slightly better quality (though could have been drbaphs was lower str?). I'll stick with this one for now for my sitcom useages which are lower res.

## fixing pause standoff

### original shot 1:

`[Shot 1] 00:00.000 - 00:05.000  

<Subject 1> (S1) while looking toward <Subject 3> says in a London cockney accent, <d>[English] "What brings you here, B?"</d>
<Subject 2> (S2) Charlie Harper is looking down and mutters in an American accent, <d>[English] the smell of human blood, no doubt.</d>, <Subject 2> is being sulky as he is not happy about <subject 3> being present.
`

### original shot 2:

`[Shot 2] 00:05.000 - 00:10.000  
The camera executes a swift 180° pan, shifting the viewpoint over the shoulder of <Subject 1> (Picture 1) and <Subject 2> (Picture 2) to reveal <Subject 3> (Picture 3) silhouetted in the doorway, his dark cape with red lining illuminated by amber light from the basement, samurai sword held ready.

<Subject 1> (S1) says in London cockney accent, <d>[English] "God damn B, you scared the crap out of me."</d>, while the rugged figure <Subject 3> from <Picture 3> Wesley Snipes as character Blade steps into view and declares in a deep south black American drawl, <d>[English] "mdkb! how the devil are you, boy?"</d>. The tension dissolves as <Subject 1> and the newcomer embrace tightly, while <Subject 2> lingers at the edge, his eyes downcast in awkward silence at being left out of the hug. `
